events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th to the one and only John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', which of his iconic moments still makes you laugh out loud?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as the 'White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed the iconic 'White Album'. Double album, double the genius. What's your standout track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury today. His voice, his showmanship, his legacy. What's your favourite Queen song that truly showcases his genius?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on this day in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic development.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles’ 'Rubber Soul' arrived, pushing boundaries and influencing generations. A true classic. Which track is still on your repeat list?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of The Beatles' co-founder John Lennon, who was tragically killed in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today. His music and message continue to inspire. What's the one song of his that resonates most with you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary musician, singer, and actor David Bowie, born in London, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's Legacy
angles.copy: The Starman would have turned 80 today. David Bowie's influence on music, fashion, and culture is immeasurable. Which of his many personas is your favourite?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', born in Mississippi, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: King's Birthday
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley, who would have been 92 today. The King truly changed music forever. What's your all-time favourite Elvis hit?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: English musician, songwriter, and record producer Jimmy Page, best known as the guitarist and founder of Led Zeppelin, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! From session work to Led Zeppelin, his riffs defined an era. What's your favourite Page guitar moment?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British singer and songwriter Sir Rod Stewart, known for his distinctive raspy singing voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod the Mod
angles.copy: Happy 82nd to the iconic Rod Stewart! A career spanning decades and countless hits. Which Rod song always gets you singing along?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the lead singer of the English ska band Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness Frontman
angles.copy: Happy 66th to the legendary Suggs from Madness! The voice behind so many brilliant tracks. What's your favourite Madness tune?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer Paul Young, known for his blue-eyed soul voice and hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Blue-Eyed Soul
angles.copy: Happy 71st to the brilliant Paul Young! His smooth vocals gave us some unforgettable 80s classics. Which Paul Young track is your go-to?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: American country music icon Dolly Parton, known for her prolific songwriting and vibrant personality, celebrates her 81st birthday.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true legend whose talent and generosity shine so bright. What's your favourite Dolly moment or song?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: English singer, songwriter, and lead vocalist of Take That, Gary Barlow, celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That's Leader
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That anthems to his solo hits, he's given us so much great music. What's your favourite Gary Barlow song?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer and songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of international R&B and pop hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Soulful Legend
angles.copy: Happy 77th to the incredible Billy Ocean! His voice is pure sunshine. Which of his timeless hits always gets you dancing?

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame's first induction ceremony (1989)
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first-ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame was held in New York City, honouring pioneers like The Beatles, Elvis Presley, and Chuck Berry.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: 38 years ago, rock history was made with the first Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction! Who do you think was the most deserving of those initial inductees?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Mark Owen, best known as a member of Take That, celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th to the lovely Mark Owen! A key part of Take That's magic. What's your favourite Mark Owen moment, solo or with the band?

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert (1969)
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Rock
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert! Imagine being there. What's your favourite moment from that legendary performance?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: English singer, drummer, and songwriter Phil Collins, known for his work with Genesis and a hugely successful solo career, celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Drumming Legend
angles.copy: Happy 76th to the multi-talented Phil Collins! From Genesis to global solo stardom, his hits are timeless. Which Phil Collins song is your absolute favourite?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, actor, and record producer Justin Timberlake, who rose to fame with NSYNC before a successful solo career, celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: Pop Prince
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to Justin Timberlake! From boyband heartthrob to solo superstar, he's done it all. What's your favourite JT track?
